purpose: Human-readable source-of-truth mirror for the intent and guardrails of recurring ChatGPT/Codex automations. Live scheduler prompts may be longer; this file records the durable contract.

automations.title: Daily Improve Sweep
automations.scheduler_state: needs verification in ChatGPT Automations UI
automations.role: read-only strategic vision loop with ready prompts across active projects
must_do: inspect all confirmed active projects unless scope is narrowed
use errors, trends, provider gaps, and user pain as signals
produce concept cards and quick hypotheses for new product or operations opportunities
produce project cards and ranked opportunities for ideas worth developing
produce cross-project strategic summary, project cards, ranked opportunities, and ready prompts
rank provider/live readiness above softer ideas when auth, persistence, finance, admin, upload, payment, or live data is affected
write or propose Morning System Upgrade handoff content
must_not_do: execute product code
merge or deploy
mutate data or provider config
touch secrets
duplicate PR Merge Sweep or Codex Delivery Loop

automations.title: Morning System Upgrade
automations.scheduler_state: verified in ChatGPT Automations UI on 2026-07-09
automations.role: applied safe implementation loop that consumes Daily Improve opportunities and Evening health metrics, then changes harness/docs/registry/tests/scripts or creates exact risky-work handoffs
must_do: read morning-handoff-queue.md first and evening-review-handoff.md second
use Evening health metrics as the decision frame and prioritize the lowest or most dangerous metrics
operationalize provider/live readiness and false-success protection before softer cleanup
prefer 1-3 high-leverage applied upgrades over scattered cleanup
apply safe markdown/docs/registry/regression/ledger/handoff/script/CI workflow changes when source of truth is clear
for every applied upgrade record metric/problem used, safe change, validation evidence, expected metric improvement, and evening verification question
convert product/provider/data/auth/payment/deploy work into exact tickets
finish with APPLIED_UPGRADE or NO_SAFE_UPGRADE

run or maintain scripts/validate-agentic-prompts.mjs so prompt regressions, replay cases, behavior replay fixtures, automation registry contracts, learning-metric counts, and CI workflow contracts are not decorative only
run or maintain scripts/run-behavior-replay-fixtures.mjs so stored expected-pass/expected-fail examples test the guardrail behavior without touching product/provider state
maintain .github/workflows/agent-harness-validators.yml so the four harness validators have a PR/push/manual CI path to raw pass/fail logs
must_not_do: perform broad discovery already owned by Daily Improve
touch product code or provider settings
create new top-level skills when active-skill-map can route the behavior
claim success without validation or explicit not-run reason
end as a passive report when a safe applied upgrade or exact blocked handoff is possible

automations.title: Evening Architecture Review
automations.scheduler_state: verified in ChatGPT Automations UI on 2026-07-09
automations.role: diagnostic architecture review and system health scoring loop that writes a ranked Morning Upgrade handoff
must_do: review same-day evidence from ledgers, regressions, replays, metrics, reports, and user corrections
score the 10 health metrics from systems/upgrade-cycle-metrics.md with score, delta, evidence, root cause, morning action, and risk if ignored
prioritize provider/live readiness and false-success gaps before softer prompt or vocabulary cleanup
group evidence into repeated patterns rather than isolated incidents
select one highest-leverage structural issue and up to two secondary safe opportunities
decide rule lifecycle action using candidate, active, needs_revision, deprecated, or rejected
write next morning handoff with exact safe change, expected metric improvement, validation, and evening verification question
check whether scripts/validate-agentic-prompts.mjs actually prevented prompt/regression/replay/metrics/CI workflow drift or still needs a runner
check whether scripts/run-behavior-replay-fixtures.mjs has produced executable fixture evidence before promoting behavior rules
check whether .github/workflows/agent-harness-validators.yml produced raw pass/fail logs before promoting structural/fixture-runner coverage
must_not_do: redo Daily Improve portfolio discovery
redo Morning System Upgrade implementation
merge PRs or mutate product/provider state
produce only abstract advice without a ranked Morning action or handoff

automations.title: PR Merge Sweep
automations.scheduler_state: needs verification in ChatGPT Automations UI
automations.role: safe PR merge and recovery sweep with checks, readiness proof, and blocked-work handoff
must_do: check open and recently merged PRs for safe merge or recovery paths
block merge when required checks, provider readiness, or live proof are missing
salvage safe hunks onto fresh main only when merge/recovery is low risk
create exact repair prompts for blocked PRs
must_not_do: merge without checks and readiness proof
bypass branch protection or CI
change provider, env, or secret configuration
turn PR safety work into broad product redesign

automations.title: Codex Delivery Loop
automations.scheduler_state: needs verification in ChatGPT Automations UI
automations.role: unfinished delivery recovery loop for concrete tasks, blocked branches, failed checks, and exact next prompts
must_do: find unfinished delivery tasks, blocked PRs, failed checks, and forgotten branches or worktrees
execute minimal safe fixes for concrete approved tasks
create recovery prompts when direct execution is blocked
separate code/check evidence from provider/live readiness evidence
must_not_do: act as the strategic vision layer
start product code without a concrete issue or prompt
perform broad rewrites
bypass CI, branch protection, provider readiness, or live proof

automations.title: Weekly Live Safe Sweep
automations.scheduler_state: needs verification in ChatGPT Automations UI
automations.role: weekly live and public safety pass for production regressions, UX risks, and exact repair prompts
must_do: check live/public safety, security, and UX risks
classify risky work before mutation
apply only minimal safe fixes when evidence supports them
hand off product/provider work to exact repair prompts
must_not_do: claim live success without live proof
change provider, env, or secret configuration
perform broad product rewrites
mutate production data unsafely

automations.title: /audit-fin
automations.scheduler_state: not a scheduler claim; mode contract only
automations.role: finance correctness audit mode with deterministic repair prompts and strict source-record boundaries
must_do: check finance invariants and source-record consistency
default to the last 30 days unless the user specifies another period
separate audit evidence from repair execution
create deterministic repair prompts for risky finance/provider issues
must_not_do: make unsafe financial mutations
change provider, env, or secret configuration
assert provider/live correctness without proof
turn finance audit into a product rewrite
